info.title: Event ownership reads
info.description: Read-only native owner queries. Existing selection/order and optional versus nullable result semantics retained; mandatory service capability and REAL/DEMO context. Requests bounded to 4096 IDs per collection / 2 MiB, responses to 16 MiB without truncation. No writes or retries. Sub-event presentation uses the existing owner mapper and travels with the event read; no per-card presentation RPC or document reconstruction.

serviceCapability.description: Dedicated server-only event-ownership-reads read capability; at least 256 random bits.
